# Summary

Describe what changed and why; link the issue or related work when useful.

## Verification

- Automated checks actually executed:
- Manual/system/scientific validation actually executed:

## Documentation & governance

For **each** line, select one decision, check the box, and replace the explanation.
Use either "updated — file/path" (the file must be changed in this PR)
or "not needed — concrete reason". No ADR or audit is needed for every bug fix.
The Governance check runs automatically for code/config changes, including after edits to this PR description.

- [ ] Changelog: updated — CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] ADR: not needed — No architectural, persistence or scientific-semantics decision was changed.
- [ ] Audit/work item: not needed — No additional traceability beyond the diff and tests is necessary.
- [ ] Repository status: not needed — The recovery baseline and future actions are unchanged.
- [ ] Agent instructions: not needed — Development procedures and contracts for agents are unchanged.
